portfolio.title: Portfolio Inputs
portfolio.subtitle: Set your investment parameters and simulate performance
portfolio.initialCapitalHelp: Your starting principal amount or lump sum investment.
portfolio.targetYearsHelp: Number of years you want to project portfolio growth.
portfolio.monthlyDcaHelp: Regular monthly savings or Dollar-Cost Averaging added to portfolio.
portfolio.monthlyWithdrawalHelp: Regular monthly cash amount planned to be withdrawn from the portfolio.
portfolio.dcaIncreaseRateHelp: Annual percentage rate to increase your monthly contribution (inflation adjustment or salary raises).
portfolio.expectedReturnRateHelp: Average expected annual nominal return rate from your investments (stocks, bonds, real estate, etc.).
portfolio.expectedInflationRateHelp: Expected annual inflation rate reducing purchasing power.
portfolio.usdRateHelp: Exchange rate between your local currency and reference currency (USD recommended).
portfolio.expectedUsdGrowthRateHelp: Expected annual percentage appreciation of reference currency against local currency.
portfolio.expectedReturnRateMonthlyHelp: Average expected monthly nominal return rate from your investments (stocks, bonds, real estate, etc.).
portfolio.expectedInflationRateMonthlyHelp: Expected monthly inflation rate reducing purchasing power.
portfolio.expectedUsdGrowthRateMonthlyHelp: Expected monthly percentage appreciation of reference currency against local currency.

validation.greaterThanZero: Please enter a value greater than 0.

projection.safeWithdrawalHelp: Amount that can be withdrawn from return without eroding capital purchasing power
projection.chartGrowthSub: Nominal Value, Inflation-Adjusted Real Value, and Invested Principal
projection.chartInflationSub: Shows how much nominal return is eroded by inflation over time

scenarios.title: Scenario Management
scenarios.noScenarios: No saved scenarios yet. Configure parameters and save your first scenario.
scenarios.duplicateName: A scenario with this name already exists.
scenarios.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete scenario "{{name}}"?

ai.modalDesc: Generate inflation, exchange rate, and return expectations for your selected currency and fill the form in one click.
ai.baseUrlHint: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. API key is optional for local servers (LM Studio, Ollama).
ai.corsProxyHint: Required for providers that block direct browser access (e.g. OpenCode Zen). The proxy URL must contain a {url} placeholder.
ai.getGeminiKey: Get a free Gemini API key
ai.disclaimer: AI forecasts are estimates for informational purposes only and do not constitute investment advice.
ai.errorAuth: Could not authenticate with the provider. Check your API key.
ai.errorNetwork: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
ai.errorQuota: Rate limit or quota exceeded. Try again later or use a different key.
ai.errorParse: Could not parse the AI response. Please try again.
ai.errorConfig: Missing required fields. Check the base URL and model.
ai.errorCors: This provider blocks direct browser access. Enable a CORS proxy (e.g. for OpenCode Zen) in the custom provider section.
ai.errorUnknown: Something went wrong while calling the AI provider. Please try again.
